empty.hint: Recommendations unlock after you pick 10 styles in Discovery.

collection.title: Collection based on your {n} styles
collection.note: The styles you picked, and below them what the recommender found close to them.
collection.legendNote: Each recommended card names the two things it shares most with your picks.

style.series: Series: this style on other layouts
style.seriesNote: The same skin, font and radius on one screen per layout family.
style.none: No composition pattern is assigned to this screen.
style.invalid: This is not a style of the catalogue.

templates.heading: Templates
templates.note: Ten page layouts as semantic HTML5 skeletons, built from kit blocks and skinned by this style's variables. One is live at a time.
templates.label: Template layouts

ball.label: Open the sphere to change recommendations

search.hint: Double-click a screen to outline it. Pick exactly 10 styles, then apply.

collections.heading: Your collections
collections.empty: Nothing here yet. Use the heart on a card to add it.

packs.heading: Packs
packs.note: Every collection is a pack: its styles with their skins, fonts and radii. Read-only.

presets.heading: Presets
presets.note: One preset per saved style, ready for the CLI (later). Read-only.
presets.empty: No presets yet: heart a style first.

design.note: Pick a mode, a skin, a font, a radius, and for each element (badge, button, card, alert, media) its own radius, density and shadow: the specimen, the style preview and the templates change at once, from CSS variables only. These are the site's Theme settings: the Theme sheet shows the same values and they are kept on this device.
design.font: Font (one font for the whole design)
design.reset: Reset to this style (clears the Theme)
design.changed: Changed from the style's own values.
design.saved: Saved to Recommended as a new style.
design.sample: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog
design.cardText: A short description under the title.
design.alertInfo: A neutral note about this page.
design.alertWarn: Check the details before you continue.
design.elementShadow: Shadow per element (cards, alerts and media are flat by default)

find.heading: Search styles
find.note: Browse every style on the Discovery wall, not only the recommendations. The address keeps your search, so you can share it.
find.label: Search
find.placeholder: Try: dark, warm, blue, poster, mesh, inter, t146
find.emptyHint: Remove a filter or change the words.

feed.heading: Your feed
feed.lead: Built from the 10 styles you picked. Tune it with Filters; the address keeps your settings, so you can share it.

closest.title: Closest to your picks
closest.note: Screens that match your layout, character and density, shown in your skin, font and radius.

structure.title: Same structure, different look
structure.note: One layout in three skins. Pick a skin to apply it to the whole feed.

opposite.title: The opposite of your taste
opposite.note: Layouts and colours far from your picks: a check that you still like what you picked.

unexpected.title: Unexpected combinations
unexpected.note: Other layout families that share your character or imagery, in mixed fonts and corners.

feed.end: That is the whole catalogue for this taste.

templates.title: Ten page templates in your style
templates.body: Landing, shop, dashboard, docs and more, dressed in the skin, font and radius of your closest screen.

design.title: Tune the tokens behind the cards
design.body: Radius, density and shadow per element, with a preset you can copy into a project.

series.title: One style across ten layouts
series.body: The same skin, font and radius on one screen of every layout family.

video.title: Watch the panorama again
video.body: Go back to Discovery and pick other screens: the feed rebuilds from your new picks.

sheet.title: Filters
sheet.note: Your current settings are selected. Change them and update the feed.

theme.title: Theme
theme.note: One skin, font, radius and density for the whole site. Feed cards keep their own design; a style page shows its style with these settings on top, and its Design system tab edits the same settings.
theme.dsNote: Every setting of the theme for the whole site, the same as the Theme panel: mode, skin, font, radius, and radius, density and shadow per element. The specimen shows the result.
theme.skinsNote: Every skin on the same few elements. Pick one: the Skin select of the Theme panel follows.
theme.fontsNote: Every font as a heading and a subheading. Pick one: the Font select of the Theme panel follows.

fontType.heading: The quick brown fox
fontType.body: Body text at the size and width the site shows now, so you can see how a paragraph reads.
fontType.noWidth: Width: only fonts with a Width axis (Roboto, Open Sans, IBM Plex Sans).

io.title: Export / import
io.note: The whole theme as one JSON config (format magazine-theme, version 2): every setting. Import replaces the theme; a style preset imports too.
io.label: Theme config (JSON)
io.placeholder: Paste a theme config or a style preset

palette.title: Palette
palette.note: One colour on the wheel and a harmony: turn the wheel and every colour of the skin follows in the same proportions. Only the colours change (the skin's own tokens); radius, fonts and spacing stay.
palette.wheel: Colour wheel: hue round the wheel, saturation from the centre, lightness on the outer ring

options.title: Options
options.hint: HSL as in the tokens (217 91% 60%) or Hex (#3b82f6, the # optional): Hex turns into HSL.
options.error: Not a colour: type H S% L% (hue 0–360, saturation and lightness 0–100) or a Hex code.

contrast.note: WCAG for normal text: every text on the palette's colours and surfaces, muted text included, keeps this ratio. AAA moves the colours further from their text.

samples.feature: Everything in Free, plus unlimited exports
samples.alertText: New colours apply to the whole site and its previews.

presets.title: Well-known combinations
presets.note: Classic and current pairings, each turned into a harmony: a card sets the whole palette.
